subject: [PATCH v4 03/19] selftests/mm: scale khugepaged's collapse wait with the PMD size

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch as reasonable, but expressed concern about increased run time for certain architectures and requested a trimming of the wait time.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch adjusts the wait time for khugepaged's collapse operation to scale with the PMD size, ensuring that large page allocations do not take excessively long on certain architectures.
